osm_tags.name: Pride of Strome
osm_tags.note: One of two car ferries used on the Stromeferry to North Strome crossing. Service terminated with the completion of the Stromeferry to Attadale road extension in the 1970s. The other ferry is on the shore east of Lochcarron Weavers, about one mile NE.
